digest.component_or_area: prompt caching warning / LLM structured run
propositions: The cache-ineffective warning fires for every small call below 4096 tokens despite the codebase already defining CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS = 4096 as the minimum cacheable prompt size, creating false positives that train operators to ignore the signal.

The warning's predicate checks only `input_tokens > 0` without checking against the cache floor, making it indistinguishable whether a zero/zero counter reading indicates caching genuinely failed or the prompt was never cacheable in the first place.

A single rebar review-plan run emits ~20 false-alarm warnings per run on sub-floor calls, while that same run's aggregate cache_write_tokens and cache_read_tokens show caching is working, contradicting the per-call warnings and undermining telemetry trust.
The fix gates the warning on `input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` with the constant single-sourced in capabilities.py, shared by both pass1.py and structured_run.py rather than hand-synced.
Post-fix measurement shows 28 sub-floor calls that previously emitted false warnings now emit zero warnings, while two above-floor calls with genuinely zero counters correctly still emit warnings.
